TOSS - Namibia have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

Zimbabwe on the flip side were well below-par in the second game of the series and their batting unit will be looking to make amends in this clash. The home side have a fine blend of youth and experience and one cannot rule them out after just one bad game. Will the hosts stage a comeback and hand Namibia a defeat in the 3rd T20I? We shall find that soon. Stick around for the toss and team news.

Namibia registered a comfortable victory in the 2nd T20I after losing a close game in the first T20I and they are a side that seems to be high on confidence. They have some quality players in their ranks and they would be looking to replicate their performances of the 2nd T20I. Namibia do have variety in their bowling attack and they will be keen to put on a show yet again with the ball.

Hello and a very warm welcome to the coverage of game number 3 of the 5-match T20I series between Namibia and Zimbabwe. With the series being leveled 1-1, both these sides would be itching to put their best foot forward and go 2-1 up in the series. This one promises to be a cracker of a game.
